---
title: "Recipe: specify, fit, transform"
format:
  html:
    mermaid-format: svg
---

A `Recipe` specifies each step for a pre-processing pipeline.
It's then `.fit()` to training data (e.g. a Polars DataFrame), and used `.transform()` test data.

* Steps operate on DataFrames, using polars selectors to choose columsn to operate on.
* Shoez extends the selection process with roles.
* Each step applies to the "output" of the previous step.
